_meta.indication: RYDAPT is indicated, in combination with standard cytarabine and daunorubicin induction and cytarabine consolidation chemotherapy, for adults with newly diagnosed FLT3 mutation-positive AML (as detected by an FDA-approved test); and for adults with aggressive systemic mastocytosis (ASM), SM with associated hematological neoplasm (SM-AHN), or mast cell leukemia (MCL)

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study A2301 (referred to as the RATIFY trial), the pivotal AML trial
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial; patients randomized 1:1 to RYDAPT 50 mg twice daily or placebo with daunorubicin/cytarabine induction and high dose cytarabine consolidation, followed by continuous RYDAPT or placebo maintenance
pivotal_trials.population: Adults <60 years with newly diagnosed FLT3 mutation-positive (ITD or TKD) AML; median age 47 years
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall survival (OS), measured from date of randomization until death by any cause
pivotal_trials.result: RYDAPT plus chemotherapy was superior to placebo in OS (HR 0.77; 95% CI 0.63, 0.95; 2-sided p=0.016); EFS also improved (median 8.2 vs 3.0 months; HR 0.78; 95% CI 0.66, 0.93; p=0.005)

key_safety: In AML, the most common adverse reactions (>=20%) were febrile neutropenia, nausea, mucositis, vomiting, headache, petechiae, musculoskeletal pain, epistaxis, device-related infection, hyperglycemia, and upper respiratory tract infection; the most frequent serious AR was febrile neutropenia (16%). In advanced SM, the most common ARs (>=20%) were nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.
target_moa: Midostaurin is a small molecule multikinase inhibitor that inhibits multiple receptor tyrosine kinases, including wild-type and mutant FLT3 (ITD and TKD), KIT (including D816V), PDGFR, and VEGFR2; it inhibits FLT3 receptor signaling and induces apoptosis in leukemic cells, and inhibits KIT signaling and histamine release in mast cells
companion_dx_detail: FLT3 mutation status verified using the companion diagnostic LeukoStrat CDx FLT3 Mutation Assay, an FDA-approved test for selection of AML patients for RYDAPT treatment

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the clinical trial design was acceptable

summary.text: RYDAPT received Breakthrough Therapy Designation in 1/2016 for FLT3-mutated AML and qualified for rolling review, held orphan drug designation (for mastocytosis, granted 4/2010), and was reviewed under Priority review; it was approved on regular (full) approval based on the overall survival benefit in Study A2301 and response results in advanced SM, not accelerated approval.

citations.quote: Midostaurin was granted orphan designation for mastocytosis in 4/2010. Based on top-line results from a randomized phase 3 trial (Study A2301), midostaurin was granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation in 1/2016 for treatment of newly diagnosed, FLT3-mutated AML in adults eligible to receive standard induction and consolidation chemotherapy. Rolling review was granted in 4/2016, with a single NDA covering both disease indications.
